caption:
Before Thursday, make sure Google shows the right hours.

Four fixes for your Google profile, all from your phone:

1. Set your holiday hours
2. Test your number and website link
3. Add your booking or order link
4. Post this week's photos

Save this and do it tonight.

When they find you, the next question is whether they pick you. We run that part too.

Let's talk. Link in bio.
alt: Before Thursday. Get your Google profile ready for the holiday. Four fixes, all from your phone. 4 numbered fixs follow.

Fix 1 of 4: Set your holiday hours. A business profile field, Special hours, changed from "Thursday · Open 9 AM to 5 PM" set to "Thursday, Nov 26 · Closed". How: In your Google profile: Edit profile, then Hours, then Special hours. Add every day that changes.

Fix 2 of 4: Test your number and website link. A business profile field, Phone and website, changed from "Website link goes to an old page" set to "Both open in one tap". How: Search your business on your phone. Tap the number, then the website. Both should work first time.

Fix 3 of 4: Add your booking or order link. A business profile field, Booking link, changed from "No booking link" set to "Book online". How: Where Google offers it for your kind of business, add the link so customers can act straight from the profile.

Fix 4 of 4: Post this week’s photos. A business profile field, Photos, changed from "Last photo added two years ago" set to "Added this week". How: Your door, your work, your space, taken today. Fresh photos show customers you’re open and busy.
That’s the profile. Next: when they find you, do they pick you?. That comes down to reviews, photos and how fast you answer. We run all of it, every month. Button: Let’s talk. Link in bio.
